title: DeepSeek-R1 Release
summary: DeepSeek's official change log records January 20, 2025 as the date when deepseek-reasoner became the new DeepSeek-R1 model, and its same-day release announcement states that the model and technical report were released with model/code materials under the MIT License.
significance: A first-party, day-precision public-release milestone for DeepSeek-R1 that can be recorded without treating the release date as the model's invention, development-start date, or evidence of broader causal influence.

verification.note: DeepSeek's official change log explicitly dates the deepseek-reasoner / DeepSeek-R1 release milestone to January 20, 2025. DeepSeek's official release page corroborates the release and states that the model and technical report were made available, with code and models released under the MIT License. This candidate is limited to the dated public-release milestone and does not infer an invention/system-birth date, development-start date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or unsupported relationship edge.

candidateMeta.admissionReason: Two first-party DeepSeek sources support January 20, 2025 as the public DeepSeek-R1 release milestone, including the official dated change log and the corresponding release announcement.
candidateMeta.nextStep: Review for chronology-safe canonical admission as a public-release milestone. Separately research DeepSeek-R1-Zero, DeepSeek-V3-Base, development chronology, geography, and any relationship claims before adding lineage or causal edges.
